explain.recovery: How recovered your body is. Below 34% is low, 67% and up is good.
explain.strain: How hard today is on your body, on a scale of 0 to 21. From 14 it counts as a hard day.
explain.readiness: How ready your body is according to JoyoFit: Primed, Balanced, Strained or Run down.

hint.hardDay: Today is a hard one on your body, so your energy and carb needs are higher than usual. Drink enough fluids too.

rest.lowRecovery: Your recovery is low: prioritize protein, fluids and sleep tonight.
rest.shortSleep: You're short on sleep: prioritize protein, fluids and sleep tonight.
rest.strained: Your body is under strain: prioritize protein, fluids and sleep tonight.

teaser.title: Food advice from your JoyoFit scores
teaser.body: Pro gives you portion and menu advice for today, worked out from your scores, your daily targets and what you've already logged.

generic.makanan: Try half a portion of rice, grilled or boiled protein, and more vegetables.
generic.camilan: Try cut fruit, plain yogurt, or steamed tofu and tempeh.
generic.minuman: Try water, unsweetened tea, or coffee without sugar.

summary.overNoRoom: Today's target is already used up.

reason.windowClosed: Your IF eating window is closed right now, so this is off schedule. The calories still count toward today.
reason.overNoRoom: Today's target is already met, so this adds on top of it.
reason.overSome: What's left today isn't enough for this, so the total goes past the target.
reason.surplus: Today's total goes past your daily needs (TDEE), so your weight won't drop today.
reason.thinDeficit: That's over your target, but still under your daily needs (TDEE). You can still save it.

reserve.safe: What's left today is split for {{upcoming}} first, and there's still room for {{noun}}.
reserve.some: What's left today is split for {{upcoming}} first, so room for {{noun}} is tight.
reserve.none: What's left today is split for {{upcoming}} first, so there's no room for {{noun}}.

reason.simple: No other meal needs setting aside, so what's left today goes straight to this.

dayImpact.withTarget: That day's total becomes {{total}} against a {{target}} target.

card.note: Just a guide, you can still save it.

story.recordingHint: Mention the food, portion and time. One minute max.

share.meal: {{name}}, {{kcal}} kcal. Want to know what you can eat today? Check out JoyoRogo.
share.workout: Just finished a workout: {{name}}. Log yours on JoyoRogo.
share.recap: My recap {{name}}: {{on}} of {{logged}} days on target, averaging {{avg}} kcal a day. Track your meals on JoyoRogo.
share.lost: Down {{kg}} kg already. Lose weight with just 3 numbers on JoyoRogo.
share.progress: Lose weight with just 3 numbers: eat, burn, sleep. JoyoRogo.
share.period: My {{days}}-day progress: meals logged on {{logged}} of {{judged}} days. Track yours on JoyoRogo.

share.copyUnsupported: This browser can't copy images yet. Use Save instead.
share.saveAskBody: To save your story image, JoyoRogo needs permission to add pictures to your gallery. It doesn't read your other photos.
share.instagramAskBody: Instagram takes images from your gallery, so JoyoRogo saves it there first, then opens Instagram. Pick Story over there.
share.photosBlockedBody: Turn on photo access for JoyoRogo in Settings, then try again.
share.photoFailedBody: Check your connection or pick another photo, then try again.
share.captureFailedBody: The preview is fine, but the image couldn't be created. Try again.

headline.fuel: Hard day, you need more carbs
headline.fuel_recover: Hard day and your body hasn't recovered

guidance.noAdjust: No adjustment from today's scores. Stick to your daily targets.

noTarget.hard: Strain {{strain}} is high: your energy and carb needs are higher than usual. Drink enough fluids too.
noTarget.rest: {{reasons}}. Prioritize protein, fluids and rest today.
noTarget.profile: Fill in your profile and daily targets so portions and menus can be worked out from your own numbers.

rest.main: {{reasons}}. Prioritize protein and fluids. Don't try to eat less than your target today.
rest.protein: Protein: {{eaten}} g so far of your {{target}} g target, {{left}} g left.

hard.carbsLeft: Strain {{strain}}: your carb target today is {{goal}} g ({{target}} g + {{boost}} g). {{eaten}} g so far, {{left}} g left. Drink enough fluids too.
hard.carbsDone: Strain {{strain}}: your carb target today is {{goal}} g ({{target}} g + {{boost}} g). You've hit it. Drink enough fluids too.

room.withBoost: {{room}} kcal left today, including {{boost}} kcal from the extra carbs.
room.full: You've reached today's kcal target, so no extra food is suggested.

basis.base: Basis: your daily target of {{kcal}} kcal, {{protein}} g protein and {{carbs}} g carbs (the same numbers as the bars in your diary), minus what you've logged today.
basis.boost: The extra {{pct}}% carbs is a JoyoRogo rule for strain {{from}} and up, not a calorie count from your watch.

eatenAt.label: Meal time
eatenAt.hint: Optional. Used to spot patterns between late dinners and your sleep.

fastLoss.title: Ease off a little
fastLoss.weight: Your weight is dropping fairly fast this week (about {{pct}}% per week). Try easing off a little and get enough protein.
fastLoss.intake: For the last few days you have eaten well below what your body needs at rest. Try easing off a little and get enough protein.
fastLoss.both: Your weight is dropping fairly fast this week (about {{pct}}% per week) and the last few days you have eaten well below what your body needs at rest. Try easing off a little and get enough protein.
fastLoss.hint: If you are unsure, ask a doctor or dietitian.
